notes.title: Sensorium Galaxy v0.4.118.10863 Update
notes.notes:
New Additions


 New Multiplayer Location Added - "Starship"
This location offers novel musical and dance experiences that can be shared with other users. Dive into the world of electronic music orchestrated by a drone DJ performing generative AI music, observe the stylized dancers enriching the atmosphere, and flaunt your own dance moves amidst Virtual Beings or fellow users.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/b14f2ca6d620ea67ffa1904316121a2216aaddb5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/917ecde6e5c83d65485973ea313fdd33574e0d6c.jpg
 Introducing the New "Cozy Shuttle" Location
This new Shuttle provides users with the captivating streams displayed on-screen, and a proper atmosphere to partake in intriguing conversations between AI-controlled virtual entities. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/a8531efe46eeb22dedc2cad76c8fc23952f4cedc.png
 A New World Selection Device Unveiled at the Starship Location
This feature offers users a seamless and intuitive way to navigate between various VR worlds. The world selector logic has been revamped for smoother transitions, with further enhancements scheduled in subsequent updates.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/d240412592a00eac393ae8c36ee026ac0a0bf3ff.png
 Multilayered Metaverse: Individual portals have been incorporated across different locations, guiding you on a curated journey through diverse experiences.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/2c920fa810fb63e9ecd9e6f5bf39b43b8431a3e7.png
 Enhanced Shuttle Location with a Dedicated Video Screen
Delve into the Sensorium metaverse video experiences directly within your virtual reality space, engaging with live streams and captivating videos.


Improvements and Changes


 Enhanced Shuttle Location with a Dedicated Video Screen
Delve into the Sensorium metaverse video experiences directly within your virtual reality space, engaging with live streams and captivating videos.
 The traditional world selection menu in the "Shuttle" location has been replaced with a teleport function that seamlessly transports the user to the new "Starship" location.
 Virtual Beings are now more interactive! Upon your arrival at a location, your virtual companions will take notice and greet you.
 Enhancements to "Salvador Dali Experience" Location.
Upgraded lighting, finessed environments, and asteroid rotation adjustments amplify the immersion effect.
 Introducing a New Virtual Being - Vinxa at the "Shuttle" Location.
Vinxa, a new interactive character, can engage users in diverse topic conversations.
 Refinements to "Audio Board" Mechanics in the "Shuttle" Location.
The Audio Board's functionality and visual effects have been optimized, particularly when users attach planets to it.
 Lighting Design Upgrade in the Asteroid Belt Location Leveraging Lumen Technology.
Lumen technology facilitates dynamic indirect lighting that considers geometry, materials, and light settings. Minor aesthetic and lighting palette adjustments, new lighting scenarios, and character lighting modifications have been implemented.
 Updated Avatar Customization System.
Expanded avatar options for user selection. Expect additional enhancements in future updates.
 Upgraded Multiplayer Infrastructure for Enhanced Stability.


Bug Fixes


 Corrected an issue causing Virtual Beings to be misaligned by planets from the "Audio Board".
 Resolved a bug that prevented the VR user's name from appearing on the multiplayer map.
 Enhanced avatar textures, lighting, and clothing color schemes.
 Resolved an issue causing brief user appearances outside the "Shuttle" location when entering the product or teleporting from another map.
 Corrected a problem affecting the planet rotation speed on the "Audio Board" in the "Shuttle" location.
 Fixed an issue that caused the Virtual Being to continually gaze at the user when approached.
 Rectified improper rotation of Virtual Beings.
 Fixed the endless rotation of Virtual Beings following greetings and conversations.
 Implemented minor tweaks to sound effects when interacting with ACS.
 Numerous other bug fixes and optimizations were carried out.

notes.title: Sensorium Galaxy v0.4.24.9168 Update
notes.notes:
New Additions


 "Asteroid Belt" and "PRISM" locations now feature enhanced visual effects around the DJ Booth and Outer ring.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/dbe039415034634a029f7b96afa4fc27e0ad215f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/9a3eeb8fcc56a46b22c3374d8fb2a3d28c32ac72.jpg
 "Shuttle" location now includes pairs of Virtual Beings with cross-context communication support, enabling AI characters to engage in deep contextual dialogues. Users can observe, eavesdrop on, or initiate conversations with any AI characters.


Improvements and Changes


 The "Salvador Dali Experience" location has been visually enhanced, with improved effects and a more stylized floor design.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/c8cdf82bc2e00648c30203e9456c9c26f6fbc385.jpg
 The "Audio Board" mechanic in the "Shuttle" location has been upgraded with a new design.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43044359/a422d29ea4b1fbe7902031d8b96a2f7b469315b6.gif
 The "Shuttle" location's World Selection Menu has been temporarily replaced for easier use while awaiting the final design. Simply touch the green square to teleport to the chosen world.
 Lighting in the "Asteroid Belt" location has been improved using Lumen technology for fully dynamic indirect lighting.
 User movement speed and inertia in the VR environment have been adjusted for Valve Index, Oculus, and HTC Vive controllers.
 The control system has been updated to the new Enhanced Input system.
 Improvements have been made to the VR IK system, primarily focusing on character leg positioning and behavior.


Bug Fixes


 Resolved facial animation issues with user avatars.
 Fixed image blurring in VR.
 Addressed turn issues with the HTC Vive Trackpad.
 Solved user teleportation problems in VR when using HTC Vive equipment.
 Corrected non-returning teleport spheres in VR.
 Eliminated freezing when returning from the "PRISM" to the "Shuttle" location.
 Adjusted character positions in the Avatar Gallery within the ACS room.
 Balanced voice levels for virtual characters in the "Shuttle" location.
 Fixed overall volume levels in the "Shuttle" location.
